text.autoconfig.standhitter.title: Standhitter Settings
text.autoconfig.standhitter.option.enabl: Automatically attack armor stands that are wearing armor while you look at them.
text.autoconfig.standhitter.option.hitAr: Attack armor stands that are wearing armor while you look at them.
text.autoconfig.standhitter.option.hitIn: Also attack interaction entities you look at (invisible click-detection entities).
text.autoconfig.standhitter.option.click: Ignores what you are looking at and clicks on the interval no matter what, even at air. Overrides the armor stand and interaction entity options.
text.autoconfig.standhitter.option.autoD: When your hunger drops to 3 shanks or less, Standhitter automatically turns itself off.
text.autoconfig.standhitter.option.keepA: Keeps simulating clicks while the game window is not focused. Singleplayer pause-on-lost-focus is suppressed while this is on.
text.autoconfig.standhitter.option.scale: Scale intervals with server tick rate
Widens the delay between hits when the server runs below 20 TPS. Example: at 10 TPS, hits are twice as far apart in real time.
text.autoconfig.standhitter.option.minIn: Minimum delay between simulated left clicks while aiming at a valid armor stand.
text.autoconfig.standhitter.option.maxIn: Maximum delay between simulated left clicks while aiming at a valid armor stand. Each delay is random between min and max.
